workflows.description: Draft one item selected while reading in a short fixed pass: one batched lookup of the item and the concepts it links in every base and in the drafts; a decision by the conflict rules; a draft citing its lines verbatim, a foreign draft quoting the web page of the work it borrows from, or a replacement of the recorded item; then check the draft. The owner accepts it.

Extract drafts for the new knowledge of a bounded scope of one registered source guided by its document type, with one batched lookup and one write pass, and draft replacements of the knowledge already recorded by the conflict rules, then list the drafts with their problems for the owner to review and accept.

Search, resolve, follow links, browse, pack and read records across every registered base read-only, deliver source:lines with evidence quotes, classify candidate identity, and refresh the derived index only when results report lag.

Install with the retrieval extra, register bases, source globs, document types and the embedding model in the home, check records against their sources, build or restore the derived index, install the Obsidian plugin and link the agent runtimes.
